scope: ordinary local source reads only; no imported provider, endpoint, environment value, credential or account read
findings: Private issuer requires an explicit supplier and qualified current source lease; there is no real default supplier.
Installed fromHttp selects relative/full credential endpoint and optional authorization-token/file from options or environment, with maxRetries default3.

These SDK source facts do not prove AWS-hosted isolation, native credential lifetime or actual account/IAM configuration.
